changes.title: Clearer navigation
changes.description: The icons along the bottom of the app now share the larger size you see in Collections, making it easier to move between screens.

changes.title: More places to explore
changes.description: Road totals and settlement boundaries are now available for 9,072 places across England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Your existing road names and progress are preserved.

changes.title: Northern Ireland county progress
changes.description: Northern Ireland's settlements are now linked to their historic counties, so they can contribute to your county progress.

changes.title: Keep up with What's new
changes.description: Open What's new in Utilities to see what each update brings. You can also contact Roadprints to report an issue or suggest a feature.
